maddeler.e:
يشلون (form I)
# يَشَلُّونَ (yašallūna) /ja.ʃal.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of شَلَّ (šalla)
# يَشُلُّونَ (yašullūna) /ja.ʃul.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of شَلَّ (šalla)
# يُشَلُّونَ (yušallūna) /ju.ʃal.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of شَلَّ (šalla) and شُلَّ (šulla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
